params.1274: Turn on run mode (click the foot icon next to your minimap in the top right of the screen).
params.1275: Click on a spot in the world to run there.
params.1276: If you run out of run energy you will go back to walking.
params.1277: You can also hold your keyboard's Control key and click to run without turning on run mode.
params.2225: Running is roughly twice as fast as walking, but requires run energy. Run energy replenishes on its own, but will return faster if you rest.
